item.title: Five Years In: Calvin School of Business Builds Leaders Grounded in Christian Liberal Arts
item.description: This month marks five years since Calvin University broke ground on a state-of-the-art facility built to equip business leaders and entrepreneurs as Christ’s agents of renewal in the world. In the years since, the Calvin University School of Business (CUSB) has translated that vision into measurable momentum—growing student demand, expanding programs, and deepening outcomes that extend well beyond bricks and mortar.
